title: Design a Global Video Upload and Streaming Platform
prompt: Design a global video product supporting resumable upload, processing, publishing, on-demand and live playback, search, and personalized discovery. Cover object storage, scanning/transcoding, manifests/CDN, metadata/index freshness, ranking boundaries, failure recovery, and creator-facing state.

response.placeholder: Trace an upload to immutable bytes, then an asynchronously published playable manifest.
response.reference_answer:
## Upload and publish
Issue scoped multipart upload credentials; verify parts and complete idempotently into object storage. An async pipeline scans, extracts metadata, transcodes rendition segments, and writes a manifest. Publish is a durable state transition only when required renditions and policy checks succeed.

## Playback and discovery
Serve HLS/DASH manifests and segments through a CDN; live streams use rolling windows distinct from immutable VOD. Metadata is a canonical store, while search indexing is asynchronous with explicit freshness. Recommendation retrieves candidates from subscriptions/history/trends then ranks under policy and diversity constraints; it is not the video-serving control plane.

## Reliability
Retry idempotent stages by asset generation, quarantine failed encodes, invalidate CDN by version, and measure upload completion, transcode backlog, playback rebuffering, search lag, and recommendation value.

## Progressive Hints
1. Upload completion is not video availability.
2. A manifest names immutable segment generations.
3. Search and recommendation may be stale independently.
